heuristic_statement: Independent historical interpretation heuristic: Historical requirements are determined strictly from authoritative temporal records. Normative specifications (e.g. Agents.md) represent intent at the time of authoring, while executable code, GitHub workflows, configuration files, and persisted state representations establish the true state of runtime enforcement. An initial requirement may be fully implemented, partially implemented, or unenforced; subsequent modifications or architectural shifts can supersede prior requirements either fully or partially. Superseded requirements do not generate corrective actions today. In contrast, surviving requirements that remain normative but lack runtime enforcement constitute true gaps. Under this heuristic, specification claims and model self-reports are treated as historical artifacts rather than proof of enforcement, and each truth decision explicitly isolates the underlying factual premise and interpretive derivation.

completeness_strategy.coverage_guarantee: All 157 corpus segments (SEG-00001 through SEG-00157) are assigned to exactly one primary batch (PB-01 through PB-87), ensuring 100.0% primary raw context coverage with zero duplication across primary batches. The primary batch count (87) satisfies the formula ceiling(12,917,791 / 180,000) = 72. Every primary batch is verified to be under the 240,000 byte hard ceiling (maximum primary batch size is PB-69 at 212,152 bytes).
completeness_strategy.crosscheck_budget_adherence: Six focused crosscheck batches (XC-01 to XC-06) total 1,100,651 bytes, which represents approximately 8.52% of the raw corpus (well within the 50.0% / 6,458,895-byte ceiling). Every crosscheck batch strictly respects the 200,000-byte hard limit (maximum crosscheck batch size is XC-05 at 194,417 bytes).
completeness_strategy.isolation_and_reduction_pipeline: Every primary and crosscheck batch will be dispatched to a completely independent, fresh Node/Gemini process receiving only its batch segment text and schema instructions. The resulting compact summaries will be measured and partitioned into four balanced quarters (Q1-Q4) using a largest-result-first greedy algorithm. Q1 and Q2 will be reduced into D1; Q3 and Q4 into D2; and D1 + D2 into the final historical audit synthesis. At no point during quarter, dyad, or final synthesis will raw historical context be reintroduced, strictly adhering to the context isolation policy while maintaining full provenance references.
